has geocode

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasGeocode
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasGeocode
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Relates a place to an alternative geocoding identifier expressed in a specific reference frame. Non-functional: a place may have multiple geocodes in different systems, and competing geocodes for the same system may coexist as standpoint-indexed claims (Principle 9).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Place -> gmeow:Geocode

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasGeocode from gmeow:Place to gmeow:Geocode when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Place, gmeow:Geocode

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to relate a place to an alternative geocoding identifier expressed in a specific frame; non-functional, so multiple systems and competing codes coexist.

Avoid when

  • Avoid it for decimal lat/long (gmeow:hasCoordinates) and avoid forcing one system's code as canonical (Principle 9).

How to use

  • Point gmeow:hasGeocode at a Geocode carrying gmeow:geocodeFrame and a value; a place may bear geohash, Plus Code, and what3words at once.

Examples

  • ex:edinburgh gmeow:hasGeocode ex:plusLoc.
